summary: Yiren Digital filed a 6-K disclosing that Executive Chairman and CEO Ning Tang became subject to criminal compulsory measures tied to an investigation involving affiliates of the controlling shareholder. The board appointed Na Mei as Acting CEO. No stake, price, premium, or close date was stated. The company said it received no official notice and cannot assess the probe's nature or outcome. The event risks impairing Tang's duties for an extended period and may hurt reputation and results. Watch governance continuity, potential NYSE notification issues, and whether the controlling-shareholder probe escalates into enforcement.
